sales_notes: High-level ask: Dedicated capacity with throughput guarantees for checkout personalization & search rerank.
Primary constraint: sub-200ms p95 for 'short' prompts (<=128 tokens), p99 target currently being negotiated (Redwood proposed 300ms p99).
They prefer pinned model variants in Dedicated but want automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variants for non-critical traffic.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to 12-month reserved pool if SLA credit and warm-pool latency behavior are validated in POC.
Quote from CTO: "We need predictable tail latency during Black Friday-style bursts — SLAs must reflect tail behavior, not just averages."
capacity_requirements: Steady state: ~40 RPS (mix of chat & rerank), peak bursts up to 150 RPS sustained for ~15-30 minutes
Target concurrency: 250 concurrent sessions (KV cache per session), avg prompt length 60 tokens, response avg 80 tokens
Estimated commit request: 8-16 x A100/H100-equivalent GPUs depending on batch sizing and kernel selection
Warm-pool: proposed 2-3 warm instances per model variant to avoid cold-start penalties
Storage: KV cache persistence for in-flight sessions (want eviction metrics and warm restore < 500ms)
Desire burst capacity policy (pay-as-you-go) to cover 2x baseline for holiday spikes.
autoscaling_preferences: Prefer proactive scale-up: pre-warm new nodes when queue > 20 requests for > 10s
Aggressive cooldown on scale-down: retain warm instances for 10m after idle to avoid oscillation
Warm pool sizing based on rolling 7-day peak percentiles, adjustable by ops team
Prefer scale actions expressed in node counts (GPU units) rather than per-request; want a simulator to validate policy
queueing_behavior_expectations: Soft queueing with backpressure: clients receive ETA and optional degrade path to quantized model
Queue threshold triggers autoscale and circuit-breaker to protect latency SLOs
Want per-route queue metrics surfaced in Console and traces for onboarding the platform team
Require request prioritization: checkout-critical > personalization > analytics
poc_metrics_of_interest: p50/p95/p99 token latency by route and model variant
tokens/sec per GPU and CPU utilization during steady and burst
queue length distributions during scale events
time-to-warm (model ready + KV warm restore) per instance
failure modes: model reloads, out-of-memory, GC pauses, and retry amplification
observability_and_ops: Need tracing of request through routing layers + per-token cost breakdown
Require token-level cost reporting for chargeback to product teams
Retention ask: 90 days for traces, 365 days for audit logs (legal request)
Integrations: PagerDuty alerts, Datadog dashboarding, SSO with Okta
poa_and_actions: SE to run second stress test with larger warm pool and staggered model reloads (by 2026-03-05)
Engineering to provide SLA draft with explicit scale-up timelines and remediation credits (by 2026-03-10)
Finance wants a modeled cost table for 8/12/16 GPU commits including burst charges
Legal to review data residency clause for EU customers; they may require regional Dedicated in eu-west-1
